claim: OU text in the first person, snappier

suggestion.to: Our Centre for Electronic Imaging (CEI) developed and tested the twin CCD370 detectors (4,510 × 4,510 pixels, derived from the CCD270s developed for PLATO) at the heart of SMILE’s Soft X-ray Imager. We’re now part of the mission’s operations team, working with the imager’s team to get the most science from the detectors.
